name: MIRAI Corporation
summary: MIRAI Corporation (hereinafter MIRAI) is diversified REIT. It has a capital contribution of 150 million yen (750 units), by Mitsui Bussan & IDERA Partners Co., Ltd. (hereinafter the Asset manager) as the founding planner and was listed on the REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 16, 2016 (securities code: 3476). As of October 31, 2025, the numbers of investment units issued and outstanding are 1,907,440 units and MIRAI owns 44 properties (total acquisition price of 180,155 million yen).
